questions.question: Use find_extremes in order to know Which combination of smoking status and alcohol consumption has the highest average vitamin C intake, and what factors might contribute to this pattern?

answer.value: Former smokers with moderate alcohol consumption have the highest average vitamin C intake. This could be due to former smokers being more health-conscious and moderate drinkers possibly having a more balanced diet that includes vitamin C-rich foods.

key_insights: Former smokers with moderate alcohol consumption have highest vitamin C intake
The difference between highest and second highest is minimal
All combinations have relatively similar vitamin C intake levels

reasoning.reasoning: Use find_extremes to identify the combination with highest vitamin C intake
